Definition: properly, a fracture, i.e. joint (vertebrae) of the neck
BiblicalUsage: The word is the joint of the neck, and it appears once, at the death of Eli: when the messenger told him the ark of God was taken, he fell backward from his seat by the gate, his neck broke, and he died.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fall is the judgment: Eli's sons had despised the offerings, and the old priest who would not restrain them broke under the news.
